description: Na₄Ti₂(SiO₄)₃ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.62 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted hexagonal planar geometry to six equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.47 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.90 Å) and three longer (2.05 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 28-37°. There are two shorter (1.63 Å) and two longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ti, and one Si atom to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing ONa₃TiSi trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one Si atom.
